title: AnimWeb-Bench: Benchmarking Animated Webpage Code Generation from Videos
abstract: arXiv:2611.09769v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Animation is pervasive on the Web, the CSS animation property alone appears on over three-quarters of webpages. Yet existing webpage code generation benchmarks target static screenshots, user-triggered interactions, or isolated motion graphics, leaving the ability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and coding agents to reconstruct complete animated webpages largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce AnimWeb-Bench, the first benchmark for animated webpage code generation from videos. It comprises 124 real-world webpages spanning 7 application domains and 33 animation types, with 91.9% of pages combining multiple types, each paired with a reference video and the static assets of the original webpage. translated_title: AnimWeb-Bench：基于视频的动态网页代码生成基准测试
translated_abstract: 动画在网页中无处不在，仅CSS动画属性就出现在超过四分之三的网页中。然而，现有的网页代码生成基准主要针对静态截图、用户触发的交互或孤立的动态图形，多模态大语言模型（MLLM）和编程代理重建完整动态网页的能力在很大程度上尚未被探索。为填补这一空白，我们提出了AnimWeb-Bench，这是首个从视频进行动态网页代码生成的基准测试。该基准包含124个真实世界网页，涵盖7个应用领域和33种动画类型，其中91.9%的页面组合了多种动画类型，每个页面均配有参考视频和原始网页的静态资源。我们进一步提出了一种与人类对齐的二维评估协议：静态外观保真度在对齐的关键帧上衡量结构、文本、颜色和视觉相似性，而动画保真度则跨帧跟踪UI组件的（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个基于视频的动态网页代码生成基准AnimWeb-Bench，包含124个涵盖多种动画类型的真实网页，并配套人类对齐的静态外观保真度与动画保真度二维评估协议，填补了评估多模态大模型重建完整动态网页能力的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AnimWeb-Bench, the first benchmark for animated webpage code generation from videos, featuring 124 real-world webpages with diverse animation types and a human-aligned two-dimensional evaluation protocol (static appearance fidelity and animation fidelity) to assess MLLMs' ability to reconstruct complete animated webpages.
